name: norm
expr: n_v2 = norm(v); n_v1 = norm(v, 1); n_vinf = norm(v, Inf); n_vninf = norm(v, -Inf); n_vninf3 = norm([-7 2 5], -Inf); n_a2 = norm(A); n_a1 = norm(A, 1); n_ainf = norm(A, Inf); n_afro = norm(A, 'fro'); n_cv2 = norm(cv); n_cv1 = norm(cv, 1); n_cvinf = norm(cv, Inf); n_cvfro = norm(cv, 'fro'); n_cvp3 = norm(cv, 3); n_cm1 = norm(cM, 1); n_cminf = norm(cM, Inf); n_cmfro = norm(cM, 'fro'); n_csc = norm(3+4i);
comment: Sig: n = norm(X[, p]). Vector and matrix norms. Vector: 2-norm default, p-norm via sum(|x|^p)^(1/p), Inf -> max(|x|), -Inf -> min(|x|) (fixed 2026-06-03; was max), 1 -> sum(|x|). Matrix: 2-norm = largest singular, 1 -> max col sum, Inf -> max row sum, 'fro' -> Frobenius (-Inf invalid for matrices). COMPLEX (added 2026-06-05): vector 1/2/Inf/p and matrix 1/Inf/'fro' norm by element magnitude |z| (norm([3+4i 0 -2i])=sqrt(29); norm(cM,'fro')=sqrt(32)); complex matrix 2-norm (spectral) still needs a complex SVD and errors (see bugs/linalg/complex-matrix-unsupported.md). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b.
